newsitem.title: NEPAL: German president ends Nepal visit.
newsitem.headline: German president ends Nepal visit.

text.p: German President Roman Herzog and his wife Christiane headed home on Saturday from an official visit to the Himalayan kingdom of Nepal.
Herzog, first Western head of state to visit since Nepal established multi-party democracy six years ago, was seen off by King Birendra.
During his visit Herzog pledged that Germany would continue aid to one of the 10 poorest nations in the world. Germany gives $28 million a year.
